interface.shortDescription: Design, build, and edit your Framer sites
interface.longDescription:
Framer is where teams design, build, and publish websites.

Share a project URL and describe what you want, from adding a section or rewriting copy to building components and organizing your CMS. Everything it changes stays editable on the canvas.
defaultPrompt: Summarize the pages and CMS collections in this Framer project
